description: This file implements SOCKS5 protocol request handling, including request parsing, command processing (connect, bind, associate), address resolution, and proxy data transfer.

classes.name: AddrSpec
classes.description: Represents an address with optional FQDN, IP, and port.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents a SOCKS5 request with command, address, and connection info.

methods.name: AddrSpec.String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the address.

methods.name: AddrSpec.Address
methods.description: Returns a string suitable for dialing.

methods.name: NewRequest
methods.description: Creates a new SOCKS5 request from a connection.

methods.name: readAddrSpec
methods.description: Reads and parses an address specification from a reader.

methods.name: sendReply
methods.description: Sends a SOCKS5 reply message with status and address.
